text: Welcome to Paw Haus. A little holiday for your best friend.
Choose your dates and the number of dogs coming to stay.
See available rooms and the total price for your stay.
Add your dog's details, your contact information, and care notes.
Review the dates, room, and price before sending your request.
Your request is saved for staff review. No payment is taken.
The staff portal keeps bookings and guest care in one place.
See pending requests, today's arrivals, and room reservations at a glance.
Open each booking to review the guest's details and care needs.
Confirm the stay when everything is ready for their visit.
Check in your guest. Every status change has an activity record.
Use the stay calendar to see reserved nights across the month.
Check room availability by date. Good stays, thoughtfully managed. Paw Haus.
